name: Event location: venues not on Exos, secret locations, TBA
description: Where an event happens, for promoters and collectives with no venue organization on Exos (docs/promoter-events.md). **location_mode**: `venue_record` (the default and every older event: a venue record of yours and/or free-text labels), `unlisted_venue` (a venue that isn't on Exos: free-text name and address, public), `secret_location` (the public, partners, feeds and the API's event answers see only the area in `venue_location`; ticket holders get the exact address at `location_reveal_at`, never later than the start, on their ticket, by email / SMS and in their wallet pass) and `tba` (to be announced; `tba_allow_sales` is your explicit choice to sell before then). Events in the last three need a capacity on every ticket type. None of them is ever linked to a venue record, so the venue gate (403 `venue_approval_required`) never applies; a free-text venue whose name and city match a venue another organization runs on Exos is only suggested (`venue_suggestions`, then POST /v1/venue-requests if you want to book it). The three public fields are also writable on POST /v1/events and PATCH /v1/events/:id, with `secret_location` as an object there too.

endpoints.description: The location mode, the public fields, the reveal time (`reveal_at`: the effective one, by the start at the latest; `revealed`: it has passed) and whether Exos sells it now (`sales_open`, false for a tba event not selling yet). With events:write the answer also has `secret_location` (the exact address of a secret_location event) and `venue_suggestions`; an events:read-only credential gets `has_secret` only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event's id. Another organization's answers 404.

endpoints.description: Changes the given fields and leaves the rest, in one transaction. `secret_location` and `tba` events keep `venue_name` and `venue_address` empty (they are public): sending one is a 400, and a switch to those modes clears what the previous mode had. None of the promoter modes takes a venue record. A live event refuses a change that would break a location rule (400 starting `location:`), e.g. a reveal at or after the start, or removing a live secret event's address. Changing the exact address after the reveal mails ticket holders the new one. Needs a key created by an owner or manager. Body: the fields below, or wrapped as `{ "location": {...} }`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event's id. Another organization's answers 404.

parameters.name: venue_name
parameters.description: venue_record / unlisted_venue: the venue's public name.

parameters.name: venue_location
parameters.description: The public area or city (alias: `area`). For secret_location it is all the public sees; required to publish.

parameters.name: venue_address
parameters.description: venue_record / unlisted_venue: { street, city, region, postal, country }, public. An unlisted venue needs a street or city to publish.

parameters.name: location_reveal_at
parameters.description: secret_location: when ticket holders get the address; before the start. Or send reveal_hours_before.

parameters.name: reveal_hours_before
parameters.description: secret_location: the reveal as hours before the start (0-720).

parameters.name: tba_allow_sales
parameters.description: tba: sell before the location is announced (true) or not yet (false). Required to publish a tba event.

parameters.name: secret_location
parameters.description: secret_location: { venue_name?, address: { street (required), city, region, postal, country }, directions? }; null removes it (not while a live event is secret).

responses.description: OK: the location as GET answers it to an editor.
A bad field, a public field on a secret / tba event, or a live event that would break a rule.

example.error: location: a secret_location event keeps venue_address empty (it is public); the exact address goes in secret_location

responses.description: The key lacks events:write, or its creator isn't an owner or manager now.

endpoints.description: Owned venues of other organizations that take booking requests and have exactly this name and city (case and spaces aside), each with `verified`. A suggestion only: an unlisted or secret event with that name is never linked or refused. To book one, POST /v1/venue-requests.
